## Quarto

Quarto enables you to weave together content and executable code into a finished document. To learn more about Quarto see <https://quarto.org>.

## Running Code

When you click the **Render** button a document will be generated that includes both content and the output of embedded code. You can embed code like this:

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(randomForest)
library(rfPermute)
library(vegan)
library(ggplot2)
```

```{r}
oculina <- read.csv("Data/Metabolomics/oculina_superset_final.csv")
ocu_meta <- read.csv("Data/Metabolomics/oculina_metabolomics_metadata.csv")

num_df <- oculina[, -c(1:27, 31358:31386)]

num_df_phen <- num_df |>
  mutate(Phenotype = oculina$bleaching)


num_df_final <- ocu_final[,-c(1:39, 16397:16426)]
num_df_final_phen <- num_df_final |>
  mutate(Phenotype = ocu_final$bleaching)


```

rfpermute symbiont density

```{r}
num_df_final_sym <- num_df_final |>
  mutate(sym = ocu_final$sym_cm2)
```

```{r}
#| echo: false

rfp_sym <- rfPermute(sym ~., data = num_df_final_sym, na.action = na.omit, ntree = 500, num.rep = 100)

rfp_sym

rfp_table_sym <- as.data.frame(importance(rfp_sym))  # Convert to a data frame
rfp_table_sym <- tibble::rownames_to_column(rfp_table_sym, var = "Feature")
print(rfp_table_sym)  # Display in console
```

The `echo: false` option disables the printing of code (only output is displayed).

```{r}
write.csv(rfp_table_sym, file = "rfp_table_sym.csv")
```

```{r}

rfp_sym_read <- read.csv("PriyasMetabolomics_files/rfp_table_sym.csv")
significant_features_sym <- rfp_sym_read %>% filter(`X.IncMSE.pval` < 0.05)
print(significant_features_sym)
```

log2fc:

```{r}

sig_rows_sym <- significant_features_sym$Feature

num_df_sig_sym <- data.matrix(num_df_final |>
  select(all_of(sig_rows_sym)))

log2FC_sym <- sapply(sig_rows_sym, function(met){
  
  B_vals_sym  <- (num_df_sig_sym[ocu_final$bleaching == "B", met])
  NB_vals_sym <- (num_df_sig_sym[ocu_final$bleaching == "NB", met])

  mean_B_sym  <- mean(B_vals_sym,  na.rm = TRUE)
  mean_NB_sym <- mean(NB_vals_sym, na.rm = TRUE)

  log2(mean_B_sym / mean_NB_sym)
})

log2FC_df_sym <- data.frame(
  metabolite = significant_features_sym,
  log2FC = log2FC_sym
)

log2FC_df_sym_upInB <- log2FC_df_sym |>
  filter(
    log2FC >= 0
  )

```

```{r}
significant_features_sym_plot <- log2FC_df_sym |>
  arrange(desc(`metabolite.X.IncMSE`)) |>
  mutate(Sign = if_else(log2FC > 0, "Aposymbiotic", "Symbiotic")) |>
  slice_head(n = 50)

significant_features_sym_plot <- significant_features_sym_plot |>
  inner_join(feats_with_classes, join_by(metabolite.Feature == metabolite)) |>
  select(metabolite.Feature, 
         `metabolite.X.IncMSE`, 
         Sign, 
         compound_class, 
         origin, 
         npc_number_superclass)

significant_features_sym_plot <- significant_features_sym_plot |>
  mutate(Symbol  = case_when(origin == "host & symbiont" ~ "h&s",
                             origin == "symbiont" ~ "s",
                             origin == "symbiosis-specific" ~ "s-s",
                             origin == "host" ~ "h")) |>
  slice_head(n = 50) 



```

```{r, fig.height = 10, fig.width = 10}

library(ggpattern)


ggplot(significant_features_sym_plot, 
       aes(x = reorder(metabolite.Feature, `metabolite.X.IncMSE`),
           y = `metabolite.X.IncMSE`,
           fill = compound_class,
           pattern = Sign)) +
  
  
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#FBE183FF", "#F4C40FFF", "#FE9B00FF", "#D8443CFF", "#9B3441FF", "#DE597CFF", "#E87B89FF", "#E6A2A6FF", "#AA7AA1FF", "#9F5691FF", "#633372FF", "#1F6E9CFF", "#2B9B81FF", "#92C051FF")) +
  
  
  geom_col_pattern(
  pattern_density = 0.2,
  pattern_spacing = 0.03
  ) +
  

  geom_text(aes(label = Symbol), vjust = 0, hjust = 0, size = 4) +
  
  
  coord_flip() +  # Flip for better readability
  labs(title = "Variable Importance after rfPermute for Symbiont Density Regression",
       x = "Feature",
       y = "Percent Increase in Mean Squared Error") +
  theme_minimal()
```
